items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Bezirksamt Beispielbek, Marktplatz am Bach 1, 22081 Hamburg erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026, sent by ordinary post by an authority. Under § 41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting = Mon 23.11.2026 (no weekend shift for the delivery-fiction day itself). Under § 31 Abs. 1 VwVfG i.V.m. § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the one-month period starts the next day, 24.11.2026, and ends under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB one month later on the day with the same number as the day of the triggering event (23.11.) i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Hamburg, so no further shift (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG).

warnings: This is a refusal (Ablehnung) of an extended opening-hours exception, not a payment demand; the IBAN printed in the letter's footer is standard office contact information and is not requested as a payment to be made in response to this letter — double-check any payment request separately before using it.

The due date for the Widerspruch (23.12.2026) relies on the statutory 4-day deemed-delivery fiction for ordinary post from a Hamburg authority; if the person can prove the letter actually arrived later, the one-month period would start later and the deadline would be correspondingly later — but filing by 23.12.2026 is the safe course.
